security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU executes an Integrated Matrix instruction (e.g., vmadd) with a C register group start index (vs2 or vd) that is not CMUL-aligned, where CMUL = VLENE / λ². The emulation accesses vector registers at misaligned offsets, reading from or writing to registers outside the intended C accumulator group, crossing register group boundaries.
security_spec.summary: CMUL register-group alignment not validated: unaligned C accumulator start index causes cross-group register access, leaking or corrupting adjacent vector register state across guest security domains
